description: A received MAX-SEGMENT caps the segments of new C_PDUs to that peer at its value x 4 bytes.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED (A-0041, A-0047). At 1500, during a burst, it sends S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (priority 0, SAP 5, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0, so TTD 1500 + 1296000000 ms, no confirmation): no SIS output (A-0095), dts.ttd starts (C-1050). At 2000 the burst's one block holds PADDING D_PDUs (type 14) to 0.0.1.2, EOT 10, each carrying one EOW; the PADDING itself is ignored (C-0588). A CAPABILITY with the Ed4 bit records its sender Ed4 (interp C-1261). Burst end 3000: csma.vdcd_end 4000; at 7000 LBT rule 1 (K-0067, K-0068), seed 0 slot 15, CONT_WAIT 45000 (K-0080). The transmit queue empties, so dts.ttd is cancelled (C-1050). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150; per rung the block bytes and ms given in the config (test data). The DATA C_PDU holds the DATA S_PDU SAP 5 to SAP 5 with its TTD; each type 7 has address size 3, and its EOT and reception window are the half seconds from the start of its block to the end of the burst, rounded up (C-0104, C-0350, C-1043). drc.table is empty: the speed stays drc.default_speed, WN 2 Long. The burst from 0.0.1.3, a peer of unknown edition, holds one PADDING with MAX-SEGMENT 2 (EOW 0xA02; C-0475), recorded (interp C-1262). Conn 1 sends 'hello' to 0.0.1.3: its 11-byte DATA C_PDU is cut into segments of at most 2 x 4 = 8 bytes (C-0476), dts.max_segment_size being 1023 (C-0523): offsets 0 (8 bytes) and 8 (3 bytes), both C_PDU ID 0 and C_PDU size 11 (C-0525 to C-0527), one size for the whole transmission (C-0549). The peer's edition is unknown, so both carry EMPTY (C-0398, C-0419) and there is no PADDING (C-1154); both start in block 0, so EOT and window 10.
